name: stm32l496
description: ST STM32L496xG (Cortex-M4F 80 MHz, 1 MB dual-bank flash, 320 KB SRAM, FMC, QUADSPI, DMA2D, SDMMC): GNU Arm toolchain with the STM32CubeL4 HAL/LL, Renode stm32l496 platform (board 32L496GDISCOVERY)

toolchain.notes: Link with STM32L496AGIx_FLASH.ld and startup_stm32l496xx.s from a Cube example (Projects/32L496GDISCOVERY/Templates/STM32CubeIDE). Whole Cube examples build with tools/stm32cube/build_example.py in the Renode tree.

image.notes: load the ELF; the vector table is at 0x08000000

renode.notes: Board platforms/boards/st/stm32l496g_disco.repl: LD2 green PB13 (active low) = led2, LD1 orange on the MFX expander I/O 4 (active low; 'sysbus.i2c2.mfx Level 4'), joystick buttons sysbus.gpioPortC.joySel (PC13), gpioPortI.joyUp/joyDown/joyLeft (PI8/PI10/PI9), gpioPortF.joyRight (PF11), MX25R6435F QSPI flash (qspiFlash, memory-mapped at 0x90000000), 1 MB PSRAM at 0x64000000, MFX at I2C2 0x42 (IDD measurement: 'sysbus.i2c2.mfx CurrentNanoAmps 1500000'). L4 core models: STM32L4_RCC (clock tree drives systick, timers, LPTIMs), STM32L4_PWR, STM32L4_FlashController (page/mass erase, option bytes). EXTI line n takes pin n of the port SYSCFG_EXTICR selects (extiMux). Not modelled yet: USB OTG FS, DCMI/camera, SAI/DFSDM audio, the ST7789H2 LCD (device models step). Docs: tools/stm32cube/README.md.

reference.simulator: none; the models are checked with the STM32CubeL4 examples (tools/stm32cube/run_examples.py with examples_l496.txt in the Renode tree)
